Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading, part of Strand 1 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading together.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy is developed as the learner manipulates electronic reference materials for information.

• Learning to Learn is nurtured when the learner uses reference materials to get information and furthers their

learning process.
